name: Fantasy Premier League API
description:
The official Fantasy Premier League (FPL) game API served from
fantasy.premierleague.com/api. It exposes Premier League fantasy football
data: all players (elements) with prices, form, points and expected-goals
stats; the 20 Premier League clubs; the 38 gameweeks (events) with deadlines;
fixtures and fixture difficulty ratings; live gameweek scoring; individual FPL
managers (entries), their squads, picks, transfers and season history; and
classic and head-to-head mini-league standings.

This API is public and undocumented by the Premier League. Read-only GET
endpoints require no authentication. The spec is hand-authored from the live
endpoints and is not an official Premier League publication. Note that every
path ends in a trailing slash — omitting it triggers a redirect.
